adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration reads the old textarea-backed setting and does `records = val.split("\n")` and inserts each `h` directly into `embeddable_hosts` via raw SQL without trimming (`execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`). If the stored value used CRLF line endings, each line except the last will include a trailing `\r`, producing DB rows like `"example.com\r"`. The model’s `before_validation` strips schemes/paths but does not strip whitespace/CR, and the `validates_format_of :host` regex won’t accept `\r`; additionally `record_for_host` does an exact `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` which will not match a stored value containing `\r`. This is a correctness bug exposed by the diff’s migration logic.
